shellCommands.command: ls /workspace && echo "---PKG---" && cat /workspace/package.json && echo "---DOCS---" && ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -ril "viewtransition\|view-transition\|view transition" . | head -50
cd /workspace && find app lib -type f | head -60 && echo "---" && cat next.config.ts && echo "---EVAL---" && ls -R __agent_eval__ | head -30
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md
for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx app/product/\[slug\]/page.tsx lib/products.ts; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat -n "$f"; done
echo "=== globals.css ===" && cat -n app/globals.css
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && sed -n '/transitionTypes/,/^## /p' 01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -80
grep -n -i "viewtransition\|view transition\|deprecat" 01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md | head -40

cd /workspace && node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log('react version:', r.version); console.log('ViewTransition:', typeof r.ViewTransition)" 2>&1; echo "--- config flag check ---"; grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -20
cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60 && echo "--- git log ---" && git log --oneline -3 && git diff --stat

git diff package.json; echo "=== vendored react dirs ==="; ls -d node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react* 2>/dev/null; echo "=== ViewTransition in vendored ==="; for d in node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental; do [ -d "$d" ] && echo "-- $d --" && grep -l "ViewTransition" $d/cjs/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; done

for d in compiled/react compiled/react-experimental; do echo "== $d =="; grep -o "exports.ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/$d/cjs/react.development.js | head -2; done; echo "=== does next alias react? ==="; grep -rn "compiled/react-experimental'" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js 2>/dev/null | head -5

node -p "require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json').version" && grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts | head -10; echo "(no output above = not typed)"; echo "=== tsconfig ==="; cat tsconfig.json
sed -n '1,45p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
sed -n '45,130p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -10
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "TSC_EXIT=$?"
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3111 >/tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "=== / ==="; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'view-transition-name[^;"]*' | head; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -c 'product-image'; echo "=== /product/classic-sneakers ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'product-hero\|product-description\|back-link' | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== errors? ==="; grep -i "error\|warn" /tmp/srv.log | head

cd /workspace; echo "=== RSC payload: transition props on / ==="; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'nav-forward\|nav-back\|morph\|slide-up\|slide-down\|product-image-classic-sneakers' | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== detail page ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/product/cotton-hoodie | grep -o 'nav-forward\|nav-back\|morph\|slide-up\|slide-down\|product-image-cotton-hoodie' | sort | uniq -c

cd /workspace; CSS=$(curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '/_next/static/[^"]*\.css' | head -1); echo "CSS: $CSS"; curl -s "localhost:3111$CSS" > /tmp/out.css; wc -c /tmp/out.css; echo "=== view transition rules present ==="; grep -o '::view-transition[a-z-]*([^)]*)' /tmp/out.css | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== reduced motion block ==="; grep -o 'prefers-reduced-motion[^{]*{.\{0,320\}' /tmp/out.css
cd /workspace; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig include (modified by next build) ==="; grep -n "include" tsconfig.json
cd /workspace; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig ==="; grep -n "include" tsconfig.json; echo "=== diff stat ==="; git diff --stat -- app lib
